source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Each friendly TECH-PRIEST model has a 4+ invulnerable save and Feel No Pain 5+, plus the Baffling Data Screed ability: during your Shooting phase, as this model's unit is picked to shoot, provided that unit isn't battle-shocked, you may roll a D6. A 2 or more lets you choose one: select an enemy VEHICLE unit no more than 12" away from this unit, which must then take a battle-shock roll at −1 (each enemy unit can be picked this way only once per turn); or this unit's ranged attacks do not stop it from remaining hidden.
